en: Vintage black‑and‑white street view of a European city corner. On the left is an ornate multi‑story brick building with decorative stonework; its ground floor hosts a shop with signage reading "Drogerie." On the right is another multi‑story building with balconies and a ground‑floor dairy shop, with signs for milk, butter, eggs, and cheese. A relatively quiet street with a few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart extends into the distance between rows of similar residential buildings. At the top in red script is the caption "Limbach i. Sa. Königstrasse." The overall layout and typography strongly resemble an early 20th‑century postcard.
